The governed ten-path ADR-0043 set is byte-identical across 38f40b46 -> 3f32c75b, 38f40b46 -> b94838b6, and 3f32c75b -> b94838b6, so this deployment introduces ZERO ADR-0043 delta. Migration state is still part of the Tier-3 execution surface and is verified, not assumed.
provenance.tier_rationale: This is NOT a data-pipeline-only change. It modifies app/strategies/engine.py (dispatch), app/services/activation.py, app/services/recovery.py, app/api/v1/strategies.py and app/strategies/base.py, and arms the factor-readiness interlock at activation, closing a known fail-open gate. Deployment changes live dispatch and activation behaviour and must be authorized as a Tier-3 live behavioural change. A successful factor refresh alone does not prove the Tier-3 portion safe.
